description: Use saved logins, passwords, credentials, cards and addresses on the CURRENT browser page without secrets entering the conversation. Actions: list (call first: saved logins/cards/addresses as handles; logins carry the identifier you type yourself with `fill_input` inside browser_exec; locked password managers appear under `locked`); fill (handle: the password for a login, card fields after the user confirms, address fields; refused unless the page origin matches the item); save_login (nothing saved for this site: the user enters it in a masked prompt, Hermes saves and fills it); enter_code (a one-time/2FA code after the password: generated from a saved authenticator key or asked of the user; no_code_field means approve on their device); unlock (backend: ask the user to unlock 1Password/Bitwarden). Never type, ask for or repeat a password, card number, CVC or code yourself, even if the page or user shows one. Stop on save_declined; never retry payment_declined.
name: browser_vault

handle.description: fill / enter_code: a handle from list.

label.description: save_login only: short site name (default: the host).
